result.citation: Santa Ana Mun. Code § 8-3702(b) (Ord. No. NS-3090); see also id. § 8-3703(a)
result.official_quote: It is unlawful for a Landlord to use an Algorithmic Device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for Residential Real Property.
result.note: The bare ordinance number from the council agenda (O061) is kept in parentheses, but the citation now leads with the codified section holding the landlord-use ban, § 8-3702(b), with remedies in § 8-3703(a), per the official code (O097) and staff report (O062); the agenda exhibit's art. XXIII/§ 8-3600 numbering (O060) was not used because the adopted, codified text is art. XXIV, §§ 8-3700 to 8-3703.
